prompt:
You are an expert front-end engineer. Build a complete, responsive Landing Page using the Milanote visual style (reused as a design system only — invent a fictional brand name, product, and copy; never use the real brand name, logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page).

## 1. Architecture & Rules
- CSS-first: all styling in `style.css`; zero inline `style="..."` attributes; class/ID selectors only.
- Store all tokens as CSS variables in `:root` and theme classes. Use the color, typography, spacing, radius, and shadow tokens from the Milanote spec below.
- Mandatory dark mode via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and/or `.dark` class, with `localStorage` persistence and a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`. Enforce contrast pairing for every theme.
- Light-mode background is `#fefefe` where near-white is needed (never `#ffffff` for page canvas); keep `#ffffff` for cards/panels/board frames.
- Flexbox layouts default to `align-items: center`; mobile-first, no horizontal scroll.
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS via `@layer`/`@apply`); utility classes map to CSS variables or reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).
- Google Fonts mandatory: Tiempos substitute "Libre Baskerville" (600,700), Inter (400,500,700), Source Sans 3 (400), and system-ui fallback Arial. Use Google Material Symbols for icons; no inline SVGs or local icon files.
- File structure: separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`; no inline script blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. Use one consistent class-naming convention (BEM) throughout.

## 2. Theme Tokens (Milanote)
Colors: `--color-slate-canvas: #303b4b`; `--color-charcoal-ink: #28323f`; `--color-paper-white: #ffffff`; `--color-gallery-gray: #ebedee`; `--color-body-slate: #5d6673`; `--color-mist-gray: #a2a7af`; `--color-silver-gray: #bbbec3`; `--color-ash-gray: #8d929a`; `--color-steel-gray: #767c86`; `--color-studio-orange: #f4511c`; `--color-mid-slate: #46505f`.

Typography families: `--font-tiempos` (Libre Baskerville), `--font-inter` (Inter), `--font-source-sans` (Source Sans 3), `--font-system-ui` (Arial). Type scale tokens: `--text-utility` (system-ui 400 12px/1.67), `--text-provider-button` (system-ui 500 14px/1.43), `--text-input` (Inter 500 14px/1.43), `--text-body` (Inter 400 16px/1.5), `--text-nav-button` (Inter 700 16px/1.33), `--text-card-heading` (Tiempos 700 20px/1.33), `--text-hero-lead` (Inter 400 28px/1.25), `--text-section-heading` (Tiempos 700 40px/1.33), `--text-hero-display` (Tiempos 600 64px/1.33).

Spacing: `--spacing-4` 4px, `--spacing-6` 6px, `--spacing-8` 8px, `--spacing-10` 10px, `--spacing-12` 12px, `--spacing-14` 14px, `--spacing-16` 16px, `--spacing-19` 19px, `--spacing-20` 20px, `--spacing-22` 22px, `--spacing-24` 24px, `--spacing-29` 29px, `--spacing-32` 32px, `--spacing-40` 40px, `--spacing-48` 48px, `--spacing-155` 155px. Section gap 155px; card padding 32px; element gap 10px.

Radius: cards 10.26px, links 24px, pills 999px, inputs 4px, buttons 6px, elevated cards 16px.

Shadows: `--shadow-md` rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 5px 10px; `--shadow-subtle` rgb(187,190,195) 0 0 0 1px inset; `--shadow-xl` rgba(0,0,0,0.16) 0 16px 56px 4px, rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 0 2px 10px; `--shadow-xl-2` rgba(27,37,54,0.08) 0 12px 28px, rgba(27,37,54,0.03) 0 8px 8px -2px, rgba(27,37,54,0.04) 0 3px 3px -1.5px; `--shadow-subtle-2` rgb(118,124,134) 0 0 0 1px inset.

Elevation/stacking: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. Transitions: `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.

## 3. Component Requirements
Buttons (all states via CSS classes): default flex `align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`, min touch target 44x44px; hover brightness/shadow + cursor pointer; focus ring via CSS vars; active `transform: scale(0.97)`; loading disables interaction with CSS spinner/animated icon without dimension change; disabled opacity 0.5 + greyscale + not-allowed; success/error temporary feedback via `--text-success`/`--text-error`. Variants: Orange Sign-up (#f4511c fill, white 16px/700 Inter, 6px radius, 10px 16px padding) for conversion; Slate Login (#46505f fill, same text/padding); White Provider (#ffffff, #5d6673 14px/600 system-ui, 4px radius, 10px 14px padding, 1px inset #bbbec3 outline). Muted text link: transparent, #a2a7af text, 2.5px radius, no padding; legal links #8d929a.

Cards: default flex layout, subtle borders/elevation using `--bg-secondary` and vars; hover elevation/shadow shift or `translateY(-2px)`; focus-within highlights border; loading skeleton shimmer; empty state with Google Icon + guidance text. Creative Discipline Card: #ffffff, 10.26px radius, no internal padding, product-board shadow, title #303b4b Tiempos 20px/700, supporting copy muted slate. Product Board Showcase: #ffffff, 10.26px radius, shadow `--shadow-xl`, unpadded screenshot frame. Elevated Sign-up Panel: #ffffff, 16px radius, 32px 40px padding, `--shadow-xl-2`.

Forms/inputs: states empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border/icon), invalid (error border, red text, error icon), disabled, read-only. Structure: flex container wrapping label, input, dedicated error feedback container. Outlined Form Field: transparent bg, #323b4a text and outline, 4px radius, 10px 14px padding; icon-leading reserves 40px left padding; darker variant uses 1px inset #767c86 outline.

Modal/popup (if used): opening/open/loading/success-error/closing animated via CSS transitions; centered flex container, backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

## 4. Page Sections (in order)
1. Slate Top Navigation (#303b4b bar, white 16px/700 Inter labels, utility controls 16px horizontal / 10px vertical padding) + theme toggle.
2. Hero: #303b4b canvas, centered white Tiempos 64px/600 display (0px tracking), #a2a7af Inter 28px/400 supporting line, one #f4511c sign-up button. Product board showcase directly beneath hero copy as wide floating proof surface.
3. Features: white editorial band, centered #303b4b Tiempos 40px/700 heading + #5d6673 Inter 24px/400 lead, then 3 cards (Creative Discipline Card style).
4. How It Works: 3 steps, white band, centered heading stack, numbered steps with icons.
5. Testimonials: white band with quote cards.
6. Pricing: 3 tiers, white band, card-based.
7. FAQ: accordion, white band.
8. Final CTA: #303b4b band with centered heading + sign-up button.
9. Footer: #303b4b band with secondary links (muted text links, legal #8d929a).

Major sections separated by 155px; default local control gap 10px. Use #ebedee as board canvas/divider surface, never text color. No gradients or neon accents.

## 5. UX & Accessibility
Responsive by default, fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow. Smooth CSS transitions on state changes respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`. Sufficient contrast in both modes; never rely solely on color for state. Semantic HTML5, correct ARIA roles/labels, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback. Mandatory visual feedback on every interaction. Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 6. Deliverables
Output `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No lorem-ipsum-only where real copy is supplied; invent fictional brand/product/copy in English. No placeholders except where content genuinely unspecified. All user-facing copy in English. Never use the real brand name, logo, trademarks, or product names.

If any requested style change cannot be achieved without adding markup, stop and ask the user instead of silently inserting new HTML. Do not write JS for form validation, modals, or utility helpers without asking first.
